title: GRAND OPENING OF THE TERROR HOTEL CASINO
physical_identity: Large Vegas-style casino sub-section inside Level 5's Beverly Room, owned by Entity 18; dim flashing lights, loud games, carpet, bar.
scale_topology: Single finite indoor casino, estimated capacity ~5000; no vertical structure stated.
anomalies: Visitors who lose Beast's wager become staff, transformed
lighting_sound: Dim lights that flash periodically; constant machine noise, blaring music, crowd cheering/jeering, clinking chips, A/C breeze.

entities.name: Entity 18 (The Beast of Level 5 / 'Mr. Gentleman')
entities.behavior: Owner; roams the grounds; offers card-game wagers (riches vs staff servitude); never lost.

entities.name: Entity 135 (The Bellhopper)
entities.behavior: Appears in the log making excited bell-ringing noises beside the Beast (TESTIMONY).

entities.name: Entity 164 (The Barkeeper / Barkeep)
entities.behavior: Runs the bar; slow halting speech; sells drinks for bartered goods/chips.

entities.name: Entity 185 (The Comedian)
entities.behavior: Log only: heckled off stage, then put on chip-trading duty (TESTIMONY).

entities.name: Louie Sulphur (casino manager)
entities.behavior: Transformed ex-researcher; roams floors offering food/drink; no prior memory.

entities.name: Casino staff incl. Peg-Leg and Sir Billiard ('Billy')
entities.behavior: Humanoid themed staff; Peg-Leg welcomes customers, Billy plays card games (sketch captions).

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Entity 18, Bellhopper (135), Barkeeper (164), Comedian (185), Louie Sulphur, casino staff
items_communities: Trade goods: Almond Water, Memory Jars, Royal Rations, etc.

entrances.method: Walk through the casino's front doors.
entrances.conditions: Entering and exiting only via front doors; open 16 h / closed 8 h cycle.
entrances.quote: The only way to enter and exit is through the front doors of the casino in Level 5

exits.method: Leave through the same front doors; chips may be traded for goods when leaving.
exits.conditions: Beast's wager, if lost, binds the player to staff service ('no going back').
exits.risk: Gambling losses; losing a Beast wager means servitude/transformation.
exits.quote: The only way to enter and exit is through the front doors of the casino in Level 5

signature_mechanic: Chip-gambling economy under a Beast who never loses: play machines, trade chips for goods, risk a winner-targeted wager that ends in staff servitude.
do_not: Do not treat the audio log events as article facts; mark as testimony.
Do not add exits other than the front doors.
Do not invent a $50 chip as real; it is rumoured only.
Do not add a survival class; none is stated.
Do not make staff hostile by default; page says generally passive.
content_warnings: mind-control / body transformation of a character (eye replaced by billiard ball, limbs by pool sticks)
conflicts_notes: Page is a layered fiction (log + emails + draft); log is testimony. Roster title 'Grand Opening of the Terror Hotel Casino' vs page title with quotes in caps. Survival class not stated.

key_quotes.quote: Level 5.1 is a large casino within Level 5 that is owned by Entity 18.
The casino is open for a period of 16 hours, and closed for a period of 8 before repeating the cycle.
the lights are dim and flash periodically, the games constantly emit obnoxious sounds
Thus far, the Beast has never lost a single game.
The only way to enter and exit is through the front doors of the casino in Level 5
